description: Gold-set for the Response Emission Validator's sentence-level decision — Charter §3.0.3's structural control: 'a response-time validator that blocks emission of a value in that field with no linked source ID. Prompt instructions alone are insufficient.' This is a pure, model-free, DB-free function, so every case here is deterministic and reproducible without a live Anthropic call. Re-run this suite (npm run eval) whenever emissionValidator.ts's blocking rules, MARKER/STRICT_ID patterns, REASSURANCE_PATTERNS, ELIGIBILITY_LANGUAGE, or NUMERIC_CLAIM_PATTERN change — that is the §6.4 gate this file exists to satisfy.

guideline-with-population.text: ADA 2026 guidance recommends HbA1c target below 7% for most non-pregnant adults with type 2 diabetes.

A second common reassurance phrasing is also blocked
